## Kinema 1.1

- **Swipe between libraries.** The Library tab now pages left and right through your libraries, Collections and Favorites; the tabs on top follow along and still work with a tap.
- **Every VidHub setting, where it makes sense for Jellyfin.** Settings has new **General**, **Player** and **Screenshots & GIFs** pages:
  - **General**: hide spoilers (unwatched episodes' descriptions and stills), the default sort and order for libraries, ask before streaming on mobile data, which libraries show, your library's film, show and episode counts, and, for server admins, **Scan All Libraries**.
  - **Playback**: **preload the next episode** so it starts at once, a **maximum cache** slider for how much video loads ahead, remember the last playback speed, background playback, and HEVC, Dolby Vision and AV1 decoding switches.
  - **Player**: when the controls hide (or never), the shadow behind them, landscape by default, screenshot and GIF buttons, and swipe-to-seek sensitivity.
  - **Subtitles**: prefer subtitles inside the video or separate files, whether embedded subtitles come on by themselves, and the language online search starts with.
  - **Downloads**: how many download at once, pause them while a video plays, and a floating progress strip over the tab bar.
- **Record GIFs** from the player, and save screenshots as JPEG, PNG or HEIC.
- **Mark intros and credits yourself** (••• in the player) for shows your server has no markers for; Kinema then skips them and shows Up Next at the credits for every episode.
- **Refresh details and artwork** for a title from its page, for server admins.
- **Poster size** now applies everywhere: Home, the Library, search and actors' pages, with a preview in Settings.
- **Appearance** is simpler: the colour option is gone. Title pages take their colour from their artwork, and everything else uses Kinema's blue. "Artwork behind pages" is now called **Blurred artwork behind title pages**, which is what it does.

## Install

Download **Kinema.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac) or **Impactor** (Linux) — or with no computer at all, through **SideStore** installed by **SideInstaller** (only from sideinstaller.net) with **LocalDevVPN** connected. New to this? Follow the step-by-step guide: https://github.com/evropiani/Kinema/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md

Installing over 1.0 keeps your servers, downloads and settings. Kinema needs iOS 17 or later and a Jellyfin server (10.9 or later; 10.10 or later for the server's own Skip Intro and Skip Credits).
